FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Clean Sweep Services, we specialize in providing comprehensive janitorial and cleaning solutions for commercial office buildings, educational institutions, and retail spaces. Our core operations include routine cleaning, floor care, and facility maintenance, all conducted during standard hours to ensure minimal disruption to our clients. We prioritize environmental safety and employee training, ensuring that all cleaning staff are well-versed in the safe handling and application of non-toxic cleaning agents. We do not engage in the handling or disposal of hazardous or industrial waste materials, adhering strictly to industry regulations to promote a clean and safe environment for our clients and their employees. Additionally, we maintain a fleet of vehicles for transporting staff and equipment, all operated by qualified drivers with proper documentation and insurance. Our commitment to quality service includes regular training sessions, safety audits, and the implementation of effective supervision policies to further reduce risks associated with theft or dishonesty.

Our janitorial and cleaning services include the handling and disposal of hazardous materials such as industrial solvents and chemicals in commercial and residential settings.
